name.title: DP_AVS_EMEM_BLOCK_HEALTH_TABLE
name.sysdesc: Contents of the EMEM NAND block health table, that contains the bad block and wear count for each block.

field.sysdesc: EMEM board id register value when this data product is generated.
Unique FSW build id number from the FSW build that this data product was generated.

array.sysdesc: Each two entries in this table represent a single blocks health table data. Data in the health table is CRC'ed in health_table_crc_size chunks. There will always be an integer number of health_table_data entries (The number of blocks in each lane is evenly divisible by health_table_crc_size)

field.sysdesc: The CRC value for the preceding health table data
